title: Manga 'Kaminaki Sekai no Kamisama Katsudou' Concludes with 14th Volume
content: Aoi Akashiro and Sonshou Hangetsuban 's Kaminaki Sekai no Kamisama Katsudou ( Working for God in a Godless World ) manga ended its serialization on October 2. The 77th and final chapter marked the end of its seven-year run. The 14th and final volume is scheduled to be released on November 30.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Gensou Suikoden' Reveals Additional Cast
content: The official website of Gensou Suikoden ( Suikoden: The Anime ) revealed additional cast on Wednesday. The anime series adapting Konami's fantasy role-playing game premiered on October 3 at 11.30 p.m. on Tokyo MX followed by Kansai TV, BS Asahi, and 32 other stations.
author: MyAnimeList

title: WIXOSS TCG to End New Production in February 2027
content: The next expansion pack will serve as a memorial for the game and gratitude towards its fans. Support for the game will continue until October 31, 2027. English releases for the card game ended in September 2025 with support lasting until that November. Takara Tomy launched the WIXOSS card game in April 2014.
author: ANN

title: This Webtoon Anime Deserves to Be the Next Solo Leveling
content: Solo Leveling has only one rival, and it should become the next Solo Leveling when its anime adaptation arrives. Following the immense success of Solo Leveling , many new series emerged, taking inspiration from its foundation.
author: ComicBook

title: Fatal Fury City of the Wolves Game's New Animated Trailer by Masami Ōbari Features Laocorn
content: SNK began streaming on Thursday an animated trailer for its Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves fighting game featuring Season Pass 3 DLC character Laocorn, from the Fatal Fury: The Motion Picture anime film, who also joined the game's roster on the same day.
author: ANN

title: Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance Film Opens at #5 in Japan
content: Godzilla Minus Zero , the new Godzilla sequel film from Godzilla Minus One 's Takashi Yamazaki , stayed at #1 in its second weekend in Japan, and sold 508,000 tickets to earn 861,165,800 yen (about US$5.40 million) from Friday to Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Magic Knight Rayearth Anime Casts Hikaru Midorikawa, Kōji Yusa
content: The staff for the new anime of CLAMP 's Magic Knight Rayearth manga confirmed on Thursday that Hikaru Midorikawa is voicing the Rune God Windom. Additionally, the anime's staff previously confirmed on November 12 that Kōji Yusa is voicing the Rune God Ceres.
author: ANN

title: Shin Oishinbo Anime Reveals More Cast, Staff, January 4 Debut in Main Trailer
content: The official website for Shin Oishinbo (New Oishinbo ), the new television anime series of storywriter Tetsu Kariya and artist Akira Hanasaki 's Oishinbo manga, revealed on Thursday the anime's main promotional video, key visual, additional cast and staff members, and January 4 debut.
author: ANN

title: 'Shin Oishinbo' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Main Promo, Winter 2027 Premiere
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tetsu Kariya 's Oishinbo manga, titled Shin Oishinbo , revealed additional cast, staff, a key visual, and the main promotional video on Thursday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on TV Tokyo at 2 a.m.
author: MyAnimeList
